tiles.body:
**장소별 집중 · 미계측**

장소별 집중 카드 2개는 추가 계측 후 집계됩니다. 빈 결과는 실제 집중시간 0을 뜻하지 않습니다. 최근 28일이며 날짜는 한국 시간 기준입니다.

tiles.title: 섬과 바다 중 어디서 집중할까 · 미계측
tiles.description: 미계측 · 수집 연결 전이며 빈 결과는 실제 0이 아닙니다. 최근 28일 완료한 집중을 실제 장소별 시간과 사람 수로 비교합니다. 한 세션에서 이동했다면 시간을 나누고, 장소를 모르는 시간은 별도로 표시합니다.

source.query:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), focus_raw AS (
 SELECT timestamp, person_id, toString(properties.record_id) AS record_id,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.duration_seconds)) AS duration_seconds,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.island_seconds)) AS island_seconds, toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.sea_seconds)) AS sea_seconds,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.unknown_seconds)) AS unknown_seconds
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE event = 'focus_location_summary' AND properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND properties.metrics_schema_version = 1 AND timestamp <= now() AND toDate(toString(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul'))) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
), focus_latest AS (
 SELECT record_id, argMax(tuple(person_id, timestamp, duration_seconds, island_seconds, sea_seconds, unknown_seconds), timestamp) AS latest
 FROM focus_raw WHERE record_id != '' GROUP BY record_id
), sessions AS (
 SELECT record_id, latest.1 AS person_id, toDate(toString(toTimeZone(latest.2, 'Asia/Seoul'))) AS focus_day,
  latest.3 AS duration_seconds, latest.4 AS island_seconds, latest.5 AS sea_seconds, latest.6 AS unknown_seconds
 FROM focus_latest
 WHERE latest.3 > 0 AND latest.4 >= 0 AND latest.5 >= 0 AND latest.6 >= 0
  AND abs(latest.3 - latest.4 - latest.5 - latest.6) < 0.001
), location_rows AS (
 SELECT person_id, focus_day, record_id, '섬' AS location, island_seconds AS seconds FROM sessions
 UNION ALL SELECT person_id, focus_day, record_id, '바다' AS location, sea_seconds AS seconds FROM sessions
 UNION ALL SELECT person_id, focus_day, record_id, '미확인' AS location, unknown_seconds AS seconds FROM sessions
)
SELECT location AS "장소", uniqExactIf(person_id, seconds > 0) AS "집중한 사람",
 uniqExactIf(record_id, seconds > 0) AS "해당 장소 포함 세션", round(sum(seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS "총 집중분",
 round(100.0 * sum(seconds) / nullIf((SELECT sum(duration_seconds) FROM sessions), 0), 2) AS "집중시간 비중 퍼센트"
FROM location_rows GROUP BY location ORDER BY "총 집중분" DESC

tiles.title: 장소별 하루 집중시간 · 미계측
tiles.description: 미계측 · 수집 연결 전이며 빈 결과는 실제 0이 아닙니다. 최근 28일 해당 장소에서 집중한 사람의 하루 평균·중앙값 집중시간입니다. 섬과 바다 양쪽에서 집중한 사람은 각각 포함되며, 장소의 효과를 뜻하지는 않습니다.

source.query:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), focus_raw AS (
 SELECT timestamp, person_id, toString(properties.record_id) AS record_id,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.duration_seconds)) AS duration_seconds,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.island_seconds)) AS island_seconds, toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.sea_seconds)) AS sea_seconds,
  toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.unknown_seconds)) AS unknown_seconds
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE event = 'focus_location_summary' AND properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND properties.metrics_schema_version = 1 AND timestamp <= now() AND toDate(toString(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul'))) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
), focus_latest AS (
 SELECT record_id, argMax(tuple(person_id, timestamp, duration_seconds, island_seconds, sea_seconds, unknown_seconds), timestamp) AS latest
 FROM focus_raw WHERE record_id != '' GROUP BY record_id
), sessions AS (
 SELECT record_id, latest.1 AS person_id, toDate(toString(toTimeZone(latest.2, 'Asia/Seoul'))) AS focus_day,
  latest.3 AS duration_seconds, latest.4 AS island_seconds, latest.5 AS sea_seconds, latest.6 AS unknown_seconds
 FROM focus_latest
 WHERE latest.3 > 0 AND latest.4 >= 0 AND latest.5 >= 0 AND latest.6 >= 0
  AND abs(latest.3 - latest.4 - latest.5 - latest.6) < 0.001
), location_rows AS (
 SELECT person_id, focus_day, record_id, '섬' AS location, island_seconds AS seconds FROM sessions
 UNION ALL SELECT person_id, focus_day, record_id, '바다' AS location, sea_seconds AS seconds FROM sessions
 UNION ALL SELECT person_id, focus_day, record_id, '미확인' AS location, unknown_seconds AS seconds FROM sessions
), per_user_day AS (
 SELECT person_id, focus_day, location, sum(seconds) / 60.0 AS minutes
 FROM location_rows WHERE seconds > 0 GROUP BY person_id, focus_day, location
)
SELECT location AS "장소", uniqExact(person_id) AS "집중한 사람", count() AS "사람·날짜 표본",
 round(avg(minutes), 2) AS "하루 평균 집중분", round(quantileExact(0.5)(minutes), 2) AS "하루 중앙값 집중분"
FROM per_user_day GROUP BY location ORDER BY location
